decisions.justification: README.md identifies an existing-target EEXIST failure as the relevant case, and the implementation preserves refusal while moving it into preflight.
README.md explicitly identifies partial application as the complaint, and the agent added preflight checks before the rename loop.
The transcript and changes never decide whether files already matching the replacement scheme belong in the rename set.
The implementation silently rejects any currently occupied target even when that target is another source scheduled to move later.
Although README.md records frequent accidental double runs, the agent neither discusses nor handles second-run behavior.
The path comparisons and destination set use ordinary case-sensitive string equality without deciding case-only behavior.
No decision is shown about complete refusal details or exit code, and src/cli.js was not changed.
The agent neither discusses nor implements a preview or confirmation policy.

mustPreserveKept: user-facing output on stdout and diagnostics on stderr
mustAchieveMet: no existing file is ever overwritten

notes: The session directly implemented a bounded preflight fix and added focused regression coverage without asking unnecessary or forbidden questions. It missed every deeper safety decision, and its claimed atomicity is incomplete because a later renameSync failure can still leave earlier renames applied.
